title: Send the owner's approved re-engagement emails to opted-in members at 14, 30 and 60 quiet days, once each, stopped by a visit

source.ref: Owner 2026-11-11 "Build this all out" (FlowWeb re-engagement email batch R1 to R3): a quiet 14/30/60-day trigger inside Frequency, opted-in members only, stopped by sign-in, sending only after the owner approves.

detail: Email Studio gains three audiences, Quiet 14 / 30 / 60 days: subscribed (opt-in) members, never demo, whose profiles.last_seen_at is that many days back with seven days of catch-up (lib/email-studio/quiet.ts). A campaign aimed at one is evergreen: sendCampaignNow refuses it, and /api/cron/quiet-reengage (daily 17:00 UTC, dark until QUIET_REENGAGE_ENABLED) sends it through sendQuietCampaign to members who newly crossed the line. It refuses unless the approval spine approved the row (assertApproved), skips anyone in the campaign send ledger (fail-closed on an unreadable ledger), enqueues with a per-campaign-and-contact dedupe key on the bulk lane, and asks the marketing send gate per person. A visit moves last_seen_at, which ends the series. No migration. Owner steps: build R1 to R3 as campaigns on quiet_14 / quiet_30 / quiet_60, test-send, approve in the queue, then set the switch (docs/RUNBOOKS.md "Quiet-member re-engagement").
